notes.title: Readable blog colors without changing saved content
notes.summary: Markdown and rich articles display custom Hex colors on contrast-safe backings, preserve Blurple's exact hue and linked author colors, and keep rainbow text readable. Display-only alpha correction leaves saved colors, private drafts and history unchanged; generated and live article readers share the same presentation.

notes.title: Blog theme and navigation contrast
notes.summary: Article headings, links, metadata, Table of Contents and keyboard focus use readable theme colors. Appearance controls and iPod reading surfaces receive targeted contrast fixes while decorative page overlays remain behind the article.
